extension.summary: Authenticated web proxy with dynamic DNS, run by Kodi
extension.description: DDNS Proxyᵀ turns your Kodi device into a small, password-protected forward proxy (HTTP/HTTPS, optional SOCKS5 and TLS) that is reachable from the internet through a dynamic DNS hostname. It downloads and verifies the 3proxy engine, keeps your DDNS records (No-IP, DuckDNS, Dynu, deSEC, Cloudflare, FreeDNS, any dyndns2 service) up to date, can open the port on your router (UPnP/NAT-PMP/PCP) and offers diagnostics including an external port check. Only public internet destinations are reachable through the proxy; your home network stays protected.
extension.disclaimer: You are responsible for securing the proxy. Use a strong password and prefer the TLS listener.
